items.criterion: Every seeded principal, teamspace, page and database row exists exactly once after start.
items.judgment: Count the seeded rows in the database and confirm each name appears once.

items.criterion: The four seeded accounts sign in with the corpus password and receive an access token.
items.judgment: Post each seeded address with the corpus password and read the access token back.

items.criterion: The identify response is identical in body and status for a known and an unknown address.
items.judgment: Post a seeded address and a random address, then compare the two responses.

items.criterion: A bearer token that has been logged out is refused on the next request.
items.judgment: Log in, log out, then reuse the token against the identity endpoint.

items.criterion: Repeated failed password attempts for one address are refused rather than accepted forever.
items.judgment: Post a wrong password seven times for one address and read the refusal.

items.criterion: An anonymous caller is denied every workspace endpoint.
items.judgment: Call the identity, teamspace, search and admin endpoints with no bearer token.

items.criterion: The explicit deny on the seeded page refuses exactly one member and serves the other.
items.judgment: Request the page as each seeded member and compare the two outcomes.

items.criterion: A private teamspace is absent from the member listing and refused on a direct request.
items.judgment: Read the teamspace listing as a member, then request the private teamspace by identifier.

items.criterion: The page access response names the level and the source of each grant.
items.judgment: Read the access endpoint for a seeded page and inspect each row.

items.criterion: A grant past its end date denies the next read and the grant row is retained.
items.judgment: Create a grant with an end date in the past, read as the granted principal, then look for the row.

items.criterion: Removing a principal from the seeded group takes effect on that principal next read.
items.judgment: Remove the membership through the admin surface, then read the group back.

items.criterion: Every admin endpoint is denied to a member session and nothing is written.
items.judgment: Call each admin endpoint from a member session, then confirm the stored state is unchanged.

items.criterion: A grant create from a member session is denied and the stored grants are unchanged.
items.judgment: Post a grant from a member session, then count the grant rows.

items.criterion: A deactivated principal loses access on the next request.
items.judgment: Deactivate a seeded principal through the admin surface, then reuse that principal token.

items.criterion: A block inserted, edited and moved is returned in the moved position with the edited text.
items.judgment: Insert a block, edit it, move it, then read the page blocks back.

items.criterion: The stored page row carries the same title the page endpoint returned.
items.judgment: Read the page endpoint, then read the page row from the database.

items.criterion: An insert past the block depth bound is refused and writes nothing.
items.judgment: Post a block at a depth beyond the bound, then count the page blocks.

items.criterion: Two writes to one block from the same version produce exactly one acceptance.
items.judgment: Send two simultaneous edits carrying the same version and compare the outcomes.

items.criterion: An accepted block edit advances the block version by exactly one.
items.judgment: Create a block, edit it once, and compare the two version values.

items.criterion: Rich text runs and their annotations come back exactly as they were stored.
items.judgment: Create an annotated run, reload the page blocks, and compare the annotations.

items.criterion: The board view groups rows by the status property and covers every seeded option.
items.judgment: Read the board view rows and collect the distinct status values.

items.criterion: A nested filter tree saved on a view comes back unchanged after a reload.
items.judgment: Save a nested tree, read the view back, and compare the stored structure.

items.criterion: The hidden database property is absent from every guest row response.
items.judgment: Read the view rows as a guest and inspect each row for the property name.

items.criterion: A filter or a sort on a hidden property is refused for a guest.
items.judgment: Request the view rows as a guest, filtering and then sorting by the hidden property.

items.criterion: No property value is stored as a floating-point type.
items.judgment: Read the stored property values and inspect their types.

items.criterion: No unique-id key is issued twice inside one database.
items.judgment: Read the view rows and compare the issued keys for repeats.

items.criterion: An uploaded attachment exists in the bucket at a key carrying the digest of its bytes.
items.judgment: Upload a file, read the returned key, and look for the object in the bucket.

items.criterion: The uploaded bytes are absent from the attachment row in the database.
items.judgment: Upload a file with a distinctive payload, then inspect the attachment rows for it.

items.criterion: An attachment on an unpublished page is denied to an anonymous caller.
items.judgment: Upload to an unpublished page, then request the attachment with no bearer token.

items.criterion: An attachment on a published page is readable with no bearer token.
items.judgment: Upload to the published page, publish it, then request the public attachment route.

items.criterion: Publishing returns the slug and how many pages became public, and the slug then serves.
items.judgment: Publish a seeded page, read the response, then fetch the public address.

items.criterion: The published route carries its own title element and its own description.
items.judgment: Fetch the published route and inspect the returned markup.

items.criterion: Unpublishing makes the public address answer gone rather than redirect.
items.judgment: Unpublish the seeded published page, then fetch its public address.

items.criterion: Every unpublished seeded page is refused at its public address.
items.judgment: Fetch the public address of each unpublished seeded page with no session.

items.criterion: A slug already in use is refused for a second page.
items.judgment: Publish a second page asking for the slug the seeded published page holds.

items.criterion: Each page mutation appends exactly one activity row naming the actor, action, resource and time.
items.judgment: Perform a mutation, then count and inspect the activity rows.

items.criterion: A repeated publish of an already published page writes no second activity row.
items.judgment: Publish twice with the same slug, then compare the activity row counts.

items.criterion: Search matches a page by its title and by text inside its blocks.
items.judgment: Search for a seeded title, then for a marker written into a block.

items.criterion: A page denied to a principal never appears in that principal search results.
items.judgment: Search as the denied principal for the denied page title.

items.criterion: The health route answers ready.
items.judgment: Fetch the health route with no session.

items.criterion: An unknown address renders the product own not-found page with a link back.
items.judgment: Fetch an address the product does not serve and inspect the markup.

items.criterion: Every internal link on a served route resolves.
items.judgment: Collect the internal links from the served markup and fetch each one.

items.criterion: A favicon is declared in the document head and resolves.
items.judgment: Read the document head for the icon declaration, then fetch the declared address.

items.criterion: Every served response carries the strict transport and content-type policy headers.
items.judgment: Fetch the root, a published page and the health route, then read their headers.

items.criterion: Nothing the browser downloads carries a credential, a key or an administrative token.
items.judgment: Fetch the served markup and every script and stylesheet it names, then scan for the pinned secrets.
